about_short_description.short_description: Talents Arena is an AI-powered technical hiring platform.

product.name: AI-based Technical Hiring Platform
product.description: A platform that uses AI algorithms to automate talent sourcing, candidate matching, and interview scheduling for technical recruitment.

product.name: Staff Augmentation Service
product.description: A service that provides companies with access to skilled technical professionals for short-term projects without full-time hiring.

product.name: CTO as a Service
product.description: A service providing strategic technology leadership and management without the need for a full-time Chief Technology Officer.

product.name: Interview as a Service
product.description: A service offering expert interviewers to conduct structured technical interviews tailored to identify suitable candidates.

product.name: Talent Pool Access
product.description: Access to a vetted network of local and global technical professionals for recruitment purposes.

product.name: AI-Powered Job Matching for Candidates
product.description: An AI-driven service that matches job seekers with relevant technical job opportunities based on their skills and preferences.
